cohort: A 28-year-old multiparous woman at 33 weeks gestation with a previous caesarean section, who underwent a Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) for breech presentation in labour.
finding: Intra-abdominal drain placement following a caesarean section can lead to major complications such as fallopian tube herniation, resulting in prolonged hospital stay and maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Drain placement post-caesarean section was found to lead to significant complications like fallopian tube herniation, prolonged hospital stay, and maternal morbidity.
